lines: The laundry is completely free today, lucky day
Even stubborn grease stains say goodbye with this
Who, who, the voice calling inside my head
Singing that I want that, I want this
I want to be happy, I want to live easily
I want to grasp you, inside your chest
Fill it with happiness and let's go all the way to rest in peace
Even the hell I once saw is a fine place, scattering love
I love you, put me down, take it all and laugh, my honey
Carbonated water that loses fizz at 4443
A hungry, twisted life that makes me want to puke
Before “there’s no endless rain”, give me that umbrella
I want that, I want this, I want everything, just emptiness
I want to be happy, I want to live easily
I want to ruin everything, I want to erase it all
Fill it with luck and let's go all the way to rest in peace
In a heaven that only welcomes good kids, I can't survive
I love you, degrade me, take it and laugh, my honey
I want to be a good kid, that's boring
Happy lucky, hello baby, sour sweet
Somehow it's an amazing good feeling
